sql: with o as (select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.strategy, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at, lo.limit_price from live_orders lo where lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and lo.side='no' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled' and lo.limit_price between 90 and 95 and (market_ticker like 'KXFEDMENTION-%' or market_ticker like 'KXINX-%' or market_ticker like 'KXINXU-%' or market_ticker like 'KXNASDAQ100U-%' or market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' or market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPSAY-%' or market_ticker like 'KXWCMENTION-%')), f as (select fl.kalshi_order_id, min(fl.filled_at) as filled_at from fills fl where fl.kalshi_order_id in (select kalshi_order_id from o) group by 1), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions where (market_ticker like 'KXFEDMENTION-%' or market_ticker like 'KXINX-%' or market_ticker like 'KXINXU-%' or market_ticker like 'KXNASDAQ100U-%' or market_ticker like 'KXRAIN-%' or market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPSAY-%' or market_ticker like 'KXWCMENTION-%') order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), q0 as (select distinct on (live_order_id) live_order_id, contracts_ahead from live_order_queue_ticks where live_order_id in (select id from o) order by live_order_id, captured_at) select split_part(o.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, o.market_ticker, o.limit_price as px, round(extract(epoch from (f.filled_at - coalesce(c.submitted_at,o.created_at)))/60.0) as wait_min, c.hot_entry as hot, c.spread, c.depth_at_best_bid as dbid, c.depth_at_best_ask as dask, c.market_volume as vol, round(c.hours_to_close::numeric,1) as htc, q0.contracts_ahead as ahead0, extract(hour from (coalesce(c.submitted_at,o.created_at) at time zone 'America/New_York')) as hr_et, case when p.pos=0 then (p.realized_pnl<0)::int end as lost from o join f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id left join execution_order_context c on c.live_order_id=o.id left join p on p.market_ticker=o.market_ticker left join q0 on q0.live_order_id=o.id order by wait_min
